title: Ebola virus disease first reported
place: Nzara, South Sudan, and Yambuku, DR Congo
summary: Ebola virus disease was first reported in sub-Saharan Africa; outbreaks have recurred since, the largest in West Africa in 2013-2016.
why: A lasting threat of deadly viruses.

notes.problem: Place over-broad: source names the two 1976 outbreak sites, Nzara (South Sudan) and Yambuku (DR Congo).
